deviations: probation is not defined in the plan or the repo. Encoded as the per-mint count of entries made by the strategy; the launch sniper enters each mint once. Breakout and reversion do not gate entries on it.
peaks is not defined by the rules. Encoded as the highest price since entry for each open position; the exit rules read entry prices, not peaks.

The baseline strategies keep their own tape in the StrategyBook instead of reading StrategyContext.tape, because recovery must persist tapes and the runtime's tapes are private and runtime.py is not in this plan's file list. StrategyContext.tape is therefore unused by these three strategies.
Fills are the Intents the runtime passes to its sink. Placement through exec.place is the intent router's job (15-06); no order is placed here.

Decision ids are deterministic strings (strategy, side, mint, tick time), not ULIDs. Entry size is a module constant equal to the replay buy amount, so the strategy modules do not import the supervisor.
Mean reversion uses population statistics over the prior ticks in the window, computed in exact rational arithmetic; zero variance and fewer than two points decide nothing.
The DEFAULTS in the three modules and the PROPOSALS table in test_registry.py are PENDING OWNER APPROVAL (owner decision 2).
